caption: Betora turns raw football data into readable match briefs. Built by alkistudio, live at betora.ro. Numbers shown are sample output from the product, not client results.

slides.headline: Fans drown in tables. They want *one* clear read per match.
slides.body: Odds, form, injuries and referee stats live in five tabs. Nobody has time for five tabs before kickoff.

slides.headline: Every match on *one* screen.
slides.body: Form, head-to-head and the model's read, stacked in the order you actually check them.

slides.headline: The same brief, *wider*.
slides.body: League view with every fixture's read at a glance.

slides.headline: Explain the *why*, not just the pick.
slides.body: Each read links back to the inputs that drove it, so the user can disagree with the model on purpose.

slides.headline: From raw feeds to a *readable* call.
slides.body: Inputs are refreshed hourly; the output is a plain-language brief with a confidence tag.

slides.headline: confidence tag on a *demo* fixture
slides.body: Illustrative number from the product mockup, shown to explain the UI.

slides.headline: Got a *project* idea?
slides.body: We design and ship products like this one. Say hi.
